about_body:
Dr. Jess founded Art of Aesthetics Dental Studio around facial aesthetic dentistry: a smile designed to suit the face it sits in, not a set of matching white rectangles.

The studio now runs in Atlanta and Beverly Hills, with minimal-prep and no-prep veneer work at the center of what it does.

services.name: No-prep veneers
services.blurb: Veneers bonded over the natural tooth, with no reduction of healthy enamel.

services.name: Minimal-prep veneers
services.blurb: A conservative preparation where the case calls for it, keeping as much tooth as possible.

services.name: Smile design
services.blurb: Shape, proportion and shade agreed with you before any treatment begins.

services.name: Facial aesthetic dentistry
services.blurb: Treatment planned around your facial features, not around the teeth alone.

footer_tagline: Facial aesthetic dentistry in Atlanta and Beverly Hills.
why_this_angle: Built the page on the bicoastal Atlanta and Beverly Hills expansion in growth_trigger, took every service from the specialty field, and reused the practice's own headline 'Where dentistry meets design' noted in website_weaknesses.
